verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local, on-device inference engine with iOS, Android, Windows and macOS apps and a local OpenAI-compatible server. A buyer could fairly ask whether it offers retention or deletion controls, for example for chat history or logs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents nothing about retention settings, history deletion or data purging. Running locally is an architectural trait, not a retention or deletion control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
